sections.Profile:
The "Perky" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on September 17, 1956, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Wood Rail, Dancing, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Williams
- Art: Roy Parker
